title: Set display sleep time when on battery
summary: Configure how long the display stays on before sleeping when the Mac is running on battery power.

aliases.text: изменить время сна экрана на батарее

steps.explain: Use sudo pmset with the -b flag to set the display sleep timer for when the Mac is on battery power. Replace <MINUTES> with the desired number of minutes.

placeholders.name: MINUTES
placeholders.description: Number of minutes before display sleeps.

rollback.explain: Restore the default display sleep setting (10 minutes) for battery power.

warnings: Setting a very long display sleep time on battery will drain the battery faster.
